section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Post-GLP-1 Weight Maintenance: Procedural Revita vs. Maintenance Oral GLP-1s
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Patients completing intensive GLP-1 therapy will transition to low-dose oral GLP-1 pills or second-generation peptides rather than an endoscopic ablation procedure.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Over 50% of patients discontinue GLP-1s within one year due to gastrointestinal side effects, cost, or fatigue; a single 30-minute outpatient Revita procedure offers a permanent, drug-free maintenance alternative.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Harith Rajagopalan: What commercial physician feedback have you received from obesity medicine specialists regarding patient willingness to undergo duodenal mucosal resurfacing vs. lifelong GLP-1 adherence?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Cash Runway Sufficiency & Financing Strategy
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: With market cap under $15M and enterprise value at $25.5M, Fractyl faces severe equity dilution risk before commercial revenue inflects in 2028.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: The 45% workforce reduction extends runway past the 12-month REMAIN-1 readout into Q2 2027, allowing Fractyl to partner Rejuva out-of-license and secure non-dilutive milestone financing.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Bradley Campbell: What is the current status of the strategic alternatives process for the Rejuva platform, and can non-dilutive upfront proceeds bridge the company through FDA clearance?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Reimbursement & CPT Coding Roadmap
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Securing broad commercial and Medicare payer coverage for a novel endoscopic metabolic device will take 3-5 years post-approval.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: The AMA has already issued dedicated Category III CPT code 1122T effective January 1, 2027, substantially accelerating hospital outpatient department (HOPD) billing and private payer coverage determinations.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Chief Commercial Officer: How will the implementation of CPT code 1122T in January 2027 streamline early commercial center activation ahead of the formal 2028 U.S. launch?
